活動說明
【Let's Talk About Session 6: 3/21】

Welcome to Let's Talk About

★Topic: The Influencer Industry

The influencer industry has transformed the way people interact with brands and media. From lifestyle content creators to professional vloggers, influencers hold the power to shape opinions and trends. How do you view the rise of influencers in marketing and society? Have you followed any influencers who inspired you? Join us to discuss the influence of this growing industry and practice expressing your thoughts on its role in the modern world.

Date: March 21 (Friday)
Time: 12:15 - 13:15
Held Online (Google Meet; the link will be sent after registration)
Host: Ariana

★本週主題：網紅產業

網紅產業已經改變了人們與品牌及媒體互動的方式。從生活風格內容創作者到專業 vlogger，網紅擁有著影響觀點和潮流的力量。你如何看待網紅在行銷與社會中的崛起？是否有追隨過激勵你的網紅呢？快來加入我們，一同討論這個日益壯大的產業影響力，並練習如何表達你對現代世界中網紅角色的看法。

參與「Let's Talk About」可獲得東華大學跨域自主學習時數喔！
